# Thunderbird Calendar create/edit attribute-driven source loader

In D321244, `CalendarDialog` defined `retainsCalendarEventSource` but the mixin reads `retainsRawCalendarEvent`. The approved unstaged correction renamed the getter in `calendar-dialog.mjs`; it passed syntax, focused commlint, and diff checks, while runtime remained blocked by a clobber build. [Task 10]

Scope: calendar.
